swiftlet.snapshot_redshifts.available_redshift_edges(redshifts, available)[source]

Edges of the available snapshots redshift ranges when some snapshots are missing.

Returns a tuple, (the available snapshot numbers in increasing order, the redshift edges of each snapshot)

Parameters:

  • redshifts (array-like) – redshift of each snapshot, in order of snapshot number

  • available (array-like of int) – numbers of the snapshots that are available

swiftlet.snapshot_redshifts.redshift_edges(redshifts)[source]

The edges of each snapshots redshift range.

Returns an np.ndarray of len(redshifts) + 1 edges, decreasing: snapshot n covers edges[n + 1] < z <= edges[n].

Parameters:

redshifts (array-like) – redshift of each snapshot, in order of snapshot number

swiftlet.snapshot_redshifts.snapshot_at_redshift(redshifts, redshift, range_tol=1e-06)[source]

Number of the snapshot whose output redshift is a given redshift.

Raises ValueError if no snapshot is at the redshift.

Parameters:

  • redshifts (array-like) – redshift of each snapshot, in order of snapshot number

  • redshift (float) – redshift of the snapshot

  • range_tol (float) – largest difference between the redshift and the snapshot’s redshift

swiftlet.snapshot_redshifts.snapshot_coverage(redshifts, redshift_range, available=None, max_spacing=0.1, range_tol=0.0)[source]

The snapshots that fill a redshift range when some snapshots are missing.

Without missing snapshots, each snapshot fills its own range. If any snapshots are missing, the available snapshots fill the range instead, each covering the redshifts closer to its own than to its available neighbours.

Returns a SnapshotCoverage of:

snapshots: the snapshot numbers filling the range (from high to low redshift) ranges: {snapshot number: (minimum redshift, maximum redshift)} missing: the snapshot numbers that would have filled the range but are not available

(from high to low redshift)

filled_by: {missing snapshot number: the snapshot numbers whose ranges now cover its redshifts}

Raise a ValueError if the redshift spacing between neighbouring snapshots filling the range is greater than

max_spacing.

Parameters:

  • redshifts (array-like) – redshift of each snapshot, in order of snapshot number

  • redshift_range (sequence of two floats) – minimum and maximum redshift [z_min, z_max]

  • available (array-like of int) – numbers of the snapshots that are available. If None, all are

  • max_spacing (float) – the redshift spacing between snapshots at which to fail

  • range_tol (float) – a snapshot edge within range_tol of the range counts as touching it, see snapshots_in_range

swiftlet.snapshot_redshifts.snapshot_redshift_range(redshifts, snapshot_number)[source]

Redshift range covered by a snapshot, with edges at the midpoints between neighbouring snapshots.

Returns a tuple, (minimum redshift, maximum redshift)

Parameters:

  • redshifts (array-like) – redshift of each snapshot, in order of snapshot number

  • snapshot_number (int) – snapshot number (negative numbers count back from the last snapshot)

swiftlet.snapshot_redshifts.snapshots_in_range(redshifts, redshift_range, range_tol=1e-09, strict=False)[source]

Returns an array of snapshot numbers whose redshift ranges overlap with a given redshift range.

Parameters:

  • redshift_range (sequence of two floats) – minimum and maximum redshift [z_min, z_max]
